# Find a Team

Source: https://www.spaceappschallenge.org/2026/find-a-team/

Join one of the teams below or create your own. Please note that all teammates, including the Team Owner, must be registered for the same Local Event to be eligible for Global Judging. Use the search bar if you are looking for a specific team name, look for teams who are still seeking members, or use the filters to narrow down your search for a team by: Skills, Languages, Challenges, and Local Event.
